epp:phrases.epp:phrase: Submit this preprint to a PCI Community for review and potential endorsement.

epp:phrase.p: This manuscript can be submitted to a PCI community for peer review. Once the manuscript has been evaluated, the community may endorse it. When this happens, a banner will be shown on the summary page indicating the endorsement and highlighting it as a “complete, reliable and citable” article.
This manuscript was submitted to a PCI community for peer review. Check the current status of the submission in the box below.
For more information please see https://peercommunityin.org

epp:phrases.epp:phrase: The PCI community has rejected the request to endorse this manuscript. You can submit the manuscript to a different PCI community.
There was an issue sending the review reuest to PCI. Please try again.

This manuscript was submitted to a PCI community for peer review. Please follow the instructions you have received by email and complete your submission. Your submission will be evaluated by a PCI Recommender, and you will be notified of their decision on whether to proceed with peer review.
The PCI community has decided to send this manuscript for peer review. You will receive a notification from PCI with the reviewer’s decision.
PCI has decided to endorse this record and has provided a link to the review.
The PCI community has decided to recommend this manuscript.

The editorial decision made by the PCI community is that a revision to the manuscript under review is required before the endorsement is possible. Follow the link in the email that you have received from PCI to read the reviews and the editorial comments. Once your revised manuscript is ready, create a new version of this manuscript. From the administration page of the new record, send a new recommendation request to the PCI community.
